test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 28 Jun 2023 Shift 4)
subject: maths
question: 15 men can complete a work in 15 days, whereas it takes 18 women to complete the work in 15 days. In how many days will 20 men and 9 women, together, complete the work? (Rounded off to complete number of days.)
solution:
Given

15 men can complete a work = 15 days

18 women can complete a work = 15 days

Concept

Total work = Efficiency × time

Calculation

15 men complete a job = 15 days

1 men complete a job = 15 × 15

⇒ 225 days

18 women complete a job = 15 days

1 women complete a job = 18 × 15

⇒ 270 days

Total work (L.C.M OF 225 and 270) = 1350 units

1 men efficiency = 1350/225

⇒ 6 units

1 women efficiency = 1350/270

⇒ 5 units

work done by 20 men and 9 women in 1 day = 20(6) + 9(5)

⇒ 120 + 45

⇒ 165 units

Total work done by 20 men and 9 women = 1350/165

⇒ 8 days

**Total work done by 20 men and 9 women in 8 days.**
